description: Post-pin source audit of the official Qwen3-ASR streaming implementation for long-session reprocessing behavior. Generation 5 is distinct from the initial official source pin, CrispASR alternate runtime audit, audio.cpp streaming/timestamp reconciliation, and 1.7B sibling audit. Source evidence only; no target-runtime, German-quality, streaming-performance or Trigger-4 acceptance credit.
generation_reason: The earlier Qwen3-ASR source generations did not bind the current upstream implementation's explicit all-audio re-feed behavior or the upstream long-session degradation report. Frankenstein requires long conversations, so this is a new source-level falsifier rather than a repeat of model-family discovery.
terminal_finding: Current official Qwen3-ASR streaming source explicitly appends each chunk to an ever-growing audio_accum buffer and re-feeds all audio seen so far at each decode step. Upstream issue #148 reports increasing long-session processing time and degraded quality from this mechanism and was closed inactive/not-planned rather than with a documented fix. Frankenstein must therefore measure latency/resource/transcript-stability versus stream age before streaming promotion.
next_discriminator: Reuse the existing T7-ASR-004 target executor after the pinned German comparator/non-speech gate. Baseline official unbounded streaming at cumulative stream ages up to at least 30 minutes and record per-chunk latency/resource slopes plus transcript stability; only then compare a separately labelled bounded-window challenger. No duplicate runtime dispatch.
